attributes.comment: CF metadata, OzFlux standard variable names. Ecosystem Processes would like to acknowledge the Yued Group of the Noongar people, the original custodians of the land on which this facility is located. These data were processed with the PyFluxPro Python suite developed by Peter Isaac, Cacilia Ewenz, and Ian McHugh, and with significant contributions from Jamie Cleverly, Jason Beringer, Helen Cleugh and Ray Leuning.
attributes.instrumentation_notes: These flux data are for the new Eddy Covariance system installed 12/2/2021. EC_7m is eddy data at 7m from 17/6/2021. 27/10/2022 7m EC East-West separation 19mm, N-S separation 385mm. IRGA is North and East of CSAT 15m IRGA restarted at 17:15 - after calibration Understorey IRGA 2169, Interface 0496 - Install at 18:10 IRGA 100mm east of CSAT and 155mm North of CSAT Ta/RH: When originally set up the data from the HMP155 15m was not recorded, and HMP45C at 2m was being written into the table as if it was at 15m. For 2011 & 2012, at L3, the AH and Ta at 2m are merged into the 15m data stream but this might be better fixed by merging in alternate data at L4. This was fixed in 2013 when the HMP45C was replaced with an HMP155 and the wiring and coding was corrected. At the end of 2015 extra HMP155(4,7 & 10m)  and Gill 2-D Windsonic4 (2,7 & 10m) sensors were added. Ts: The original metadata stated one TCAV was at 10cm and the other at 20cm, both soil temperature measurements were made at 10cm. Previous data processing used only a single sensor to determine Ts. I have now made this the average of both sensors. After 25/11/2015 the TCAV sensors were installed at 4cm, to better sense the soil above the heat flux plates. Fn: The CNR1 4-component radiometer was installed in 2011 and is retained as a backup, with components Fsd_1, Fld_1, Fsu_1 and Fdu_1. An NR-Lite2 was installed at the end of 2015, along with an Apogee infrared thermometer. Precip: The main rain gauge malfunctioned from 14th Nov to 31st Dec 2019. These data are excluded at L2. Never worked out what happened. 30/9-4/10/2021	Tower rain gauge had some weird bogus records 575mm, that have been removed 2/11-5/11/2021	Tower rain gauge had some weird bogus records 160mm, that have been removed GG Sth raingauge removed for maintenance between 19/7/2022 and 20/10/2022 Wind Profile: The Windsonic 2-D anemometers were originally installed without correct North orientation. These were corrected to N on 31/1/2022. Prior to this wind direction had to be corrected by regression correlation in Gingin. This correction is now correctly included in the Wd_WS4_ data. Watertable: level and temperature recording began in 2021.
